physics.hub_u_scheme: GGA+U Dudarev, Ueff(Ag-4d)=4.0 eV [Derzsi et al. PRB 105, L081113 (2022), as cited by Zhu et al. SM Sec. 2]
physics.kmesh: k-spacing 0.02*2*pi/Angstrom (authors' protocol); explicit rounding: N_i = floor(2*pi/(a_i*Delta_k)) + 1 -> initial candidate 14x9x1 (Gamma-centered) for a=3.827, b=5.880 A (N_a=13.06, N_b=8.50); k-convergence sweep (12x8, 14x9, 16x10) to be recorded before production runs
physics.kmesh_note: integer mesh is an OPERATOR CHOICE (not an author parameter): Gamma-centered initial candidate 14x9x1 (14 even x 9 odd - Gamma-centered grids may mix parity; parity recorded as an operator choice); Gamma vs Monkhorst-Pack, ISMEAR/SIGMA to be decided and recorded in the convergence record
physics.ismear_sigma_note: operator choice to be frozen with the k-mesh: ISMEAR/SIGMA appropriate to the (insulating) state, recorded in the convergence record
physics.magnetic_moment_init: MAGMOM initialization is an operator choice (collinear Ag +-x patterns for Type-I/II); exact values to be recorded before production runs
physics.dipole_correction_note: slab dipole correction (or its absence) is an operator choice; SM does not state it - to be decided and recorded
physics.pseudopotential_note: PAW POTCAR version NOT published in SM; lock must be established from the local VASP installation before any DFT run (never fabricated)
physics.magnetic_order_note: stage-1 contract uses type_I (ground state per paper). Per the paper's definitions (main text Fig. 2(b)/(c); SM Sec. 1/3): type_I = interlayer Neel vectors OPPOSITE, connected by the UNITARY {m_001|t_o2} (axial-vector rule: in-plane S_x -> -S_x); type_II = Neel vectors SAME, connected by the ANTIUNITARY {m'_001|t_o2} (S_x -> +S_x). MAGMOM initialization must follow these patterns.

B2.note: built from C2DB 2AgF2-1 monolayer via Ohat={m_001|(0.5,0.16)}; NOT the authors' relaxed B2 (not public)
